title: The Soft Blanket
text:
My grandmother has a soft blanket. It is made of wool, so it feels warm and thick. The blanket is light blue with small white stripes. I use it every winter when I read books on the sofa.

The kitchen table is made of wood. It is hard and smooth, and it has a few small marks on it. My family eats breakfast at this table every day. We like the rough chairs in the corner because they are old and strong.

questions.text: What is the blanket made of?
What is the kitchen table made of?
Why does the writer use the blanket in winter?
options: It is a warm and comfortable material
It is too heavy to move
It is made to be wet

questions.text: What can we infer about the chairs in the corner?
options: They are old but still good

vocabulary.definition: a large soft cover for keeping warm in bed
flat and even, without rough parts
not smooth, with an uneven surface
wide from one side to the other

paragraph_translations: У моєї бабусі є м'яка ковдра. Вона зроблена з вовни, тому відчувається теплою і товстою. Ковдра світло-блакитна з дрібними білими смужками. Я користуюся нею щозими, коли читаю книжки на дивані.
Кухонний стіл зроблений з дерева. Він твердий і гладкий, і на ньому є кілька маленьких слідів. Моя родина щодня снідає за цим столом. Нам подобаються шорсткі стільці в кутку, бо вони старі й міцні.
